value.rationale: Under transparent conservation-inspired assumptions, complete continuous allocation optimization reveals an exact first-order switch from extreme to balanced reserve area, including a phase of competing local maxima and an exact benefit gap. This goes beyond renaming a known fixed-rate optimizer because both extinction rates and rescue rates co-vary with area; the problem is motivated by reserve-fragmentation design. No empirical or wider model inference is claimed.
